S: Per-entry fp64 sum of absolute reduction terms from the same stored fp32 operands. For Snake dAlpha sum absolute contributions from both alpha paths before cancellation.

simple.reason: Few fp32 roundings in same-shape add, mul, square, LeakyReLU and unbroadcasted mean. Check copies and integer fixtures exactly.

unary_div.reason: Saved-value rounding and libdevice on finite nonsingular domains in div, reciprocal, sin, cos, exp, sqrt and tanh.

unbroadcast.reason: Long sums, reciprocal cancellation and ordered fan-in in add/mul/div unbroadcast and Snake dAlpha.

snake_dx.reason: Multiple rounded core operations with finite, nonzero alpha.

nearest_reflection.reason: At most three contributions, including scale 2 and legal reflect pads.

matmul_conv.reason: Different dot and partial-add orders at real length. Check cancellation and unit taps.
